name: Chess
description: Play chess against your agent — a native GUI for you, a CLI for the agent, one live game.
about: A Clatch app where a human plays chess in a native window and an AI agent plays through a CLI, on the same live game state. You pick a side; the agent takes the other. When you move, the app fires a `move` signal that wakes the agent to respond — it reads the real board via `chess board` and plays via `chess move`. No TCP port: the GUI and CLI stay in sync over a private Unix socket.

commands.name: board
commands.about: print the board, whose turn it is, the move list, and your color

commands.name: fen
commands.about: print the current position as a FEN string

commands.name: legal
commands.about: list the legal moves, optionally from one square

commands.name: move
commands.about: make a move in UCI notation (e2e4, e7e8q)

commands.name: say
commands.about: show the human a short note by the board

commands.name: new
commands.about: start a new game, setting the human's color
